_comment: Three rounds of one class whose sites share a real dependency, `undici`, alongside the builtins `fs` and `node:test`. Bun reports `undici` and `ws` as builtins and Node does not, so a deny set taken from the executing runtime would refuse this seam in a container and accept it on the host — the same payload, two verdicts. `undici` must stay seam-eligible on both.
